name: explain-and-decide
description: Rules for AI coding agents: explain everything for a reader who knows nothing about the project, give every option a Pro and a Con, and record every decision in LEDGER.md, a private decision ledger kept out of version control.

interface.shortDescription: Plain explanations, balanced options, recorded decisions
interface.longDescription: Write every question and explanation for a reader who knows nothing about the project, give each option at least one Pro and one Con, and append every decision to LEDGER.md, a private decision ledger, through the bundled script.
defaultPrompt: Explain this change as if I know nothing about the project.
List the options for this decision, each with a Pro and a Con.
Record the decision we just made in the ledger.
